title: Generative artificial intelligence prompting strategies among Chinese university students across academic tasks
abstract: arXiv:2610.39571v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) is increasingly embedded in university learning, yet effective human-GenAI interaction depends not only on access to these tools but also on students' ability to formulate, evaluate, and refine prompts for academic tasks. This study examined university students' perceived GenAI prompting capability and reported prompting strategies. Questionnaire data from 234 students were analyzed using descriptive statistics, measurement modelling, scenario comparisons, structural associations, and qualitative coding of optional comments. Students reported using GenAI across diverse academic activities and generally expressed confidence in their prompting capabilities, particularly in providing relevant context and refining prompts following initial outputs. However, prompting strategies showed limited sensitivity to task types: specifying output format was more strongly endorsed in a creative workshop prep

translated_title: 中国大学生在不同学术任务中的生成式人工智能提示策略
translated_abstract: 生成式人工智能日益融入大学学习之中，然而有效的人机（GenAI）交互不仅取决于能否使用这些工具，还取决于学生为学术任务构建、评估和改进提示词的能力。本研究考察了大学生对自身GenAI提示能力的感知及其所报告的提示策略。研究采用描述性统计、测量建模、情境比较、结构关联分析以及可选评论的定性编码等方法，对234名学生的问卷数据进行了分析。学生报告在各种学术活动中使用GenAI，并普遍对自身提示能力表示有信心，尤其是在提供相关背景信息以及根据初始输出改进提示词方面。然而，提示策略对不同任务类型的敏感性有限：在创意工作坊准备情境中，指定输出格式这一策略得到了更强的认可（摘要原文不完整，此处为现有内容之翻译）
tldr: 本研究通过对234名中国大学生的问卷调查发现，学生虽普遍对生成式AI提示能力有信心，但其提示策略对不同学术任务类型的适配性有限。
en_tdlr: This study of 234 Chinese university students found that while students generally expressed confidence in their GenAI prompting capabilities, their prompting strategies showed limited sensitivity to different academic task types.
